transformer_encoder.label: Transformer Encoder
transformer_encoder.description: Bidirectional representation modeling utilizing attention mechanisms.

decision_flow.question: Do you need bidirectional context for extracting text features or classification?
decision_flow.if_yes: Use BERT or standard Transformer Encoder layers.
decision_flow.if_no: Use GPT causal decoders for text generation.

transformer_decoder.label: Transformer Decoder
transformer_decoder.description: Autoregressive generation architectures predicting sequence tokens sequentially.

decision_flow.question: Are you building text generators or multi-turn chat applications?
decision_flow.if_no: Use Encoder models (BERT) for feature retrieval.

convolutional.label: Convolutional Neural Networks
convolutional.description: Grid-based feature learning leveraging weight sharing and translation invariance.

decision_flow.question: Are you processing spatial image pixels with low-latency edge constraints?
decision_flow.if_no: Consider ResNet backbones or Vision Transformers (ViT) for high-performance benchmarks.

vision_backbone.label: Vision Backbone
vision_backbone.description: Deep architectures extracting representations from image pixel arrays.

decision_flow.question: Is your dataset size small or moderate?
decision_flow.if_yes: Use ResNet (leverages convolution spatial inductive biases).
decision_flow.if_no: Use Vision Transformers (ViT) to scale representations on massive data.

vision_detection.label: Object Detection
vision_detection.description: Locating bounding boxes and classifying multiple objects in single images.

decision_flow.question: Do you need real-time edge processing (60+ FPS)?
decision_flow.if_no: Use slower, higher-resolution regional architectures like Faster R-CNN.

vision_segmentation.label: Image Segmentation
vision_segmentation.description: Pixel-level classification maps detailing shapes and layouts.

decision_flow.question: Do you need precise localization details with skip connection safety?
decision_flow.if_no: Consider standard CNNs if bounding box coordinate bounds suffice.

recurrent_sequence.label: Recurrent Sequence
recurrent_sequence.description: Sequence processing using recurrent cells tracking state variables.

decision_flow.question: Do you have strict low-latency streaming inputs and low memory budgets?
decision_flow.if_no: Use Transformers for parallel training and deep context windows.

decision_flow.question: Do you need to model non-linear mappings for encoding or denoising images?
decision_flow.if_no: Use statistical PCA for fast linear transformations.

generative_adversarial.label: Generative Adversarial Networks
generative_adversarial.description: Zero-sum minimax generator and discriminator training pipelines.

decision_flow.question: Are you generating sharp image outputs with low generation latency?
decision_flow.if_no: Consider Diffusion Models for more stable, diverse generations.

diffusion.label: Diffusion Models
diffusion.description: Generative systems modeling reverse noise corruption step-by-step.

decision_flow.question: Is output diversity and high generation fidelity worth multi-step inference latency?
decision_flow.if_no: Use GANs for fast single-pass generations.

graph_neural_network.label: Graph Neural Networks
graph_neural_network.description: Processing relational network arrays natively via message passing.

decision_flow.question: Is your data structured natively as non-Euclidean graphs (molecules, networks)?
decision_flow.if_no: Convert structure into linear/tabular formats for standard classifiers.

reinforcement_learning.label: Reinforcement Learning
reinforcement_learning.description: Autonomous control policy learning based on feedback rewards.

decision_flow.question: Is your action space discrete and environment simulations are available?
decision_flow.if_no: Use Policy Gradient algorithms for continuous action spaces.
